baseline.approval: Some native transactional fixtures use explicitly TEST-ONLY MOCK acceptance; not human approval UX evidence

requirements.evidence: Canonical project identity/schema/file SHA/update/stale, excludes hidden/generated directories and binary text
Unchanged-file and metadata reuse; optional nonpersistent watcher; explicit rescan/forceHash recovers create/change/delete/rename and missed events
Lexical declarations/nodes/ext-subresources/UID and reverse graph; ambiguous UID/missing or unsafe references remain unresolved; binary never decoded
Bounded memory-only four-entry LRU, no database or new dependency
File/directory/byte/text/metadata/graph/queue bounds; pre/queued/active cancellation atomicity; public search/info cache and stale metadata

limitations: Lexical context, safeRefactor:false; not complete dynamic/escaped/complex script-resource semantics
Overlong lexical lines stop extraction explicitly at omittedFromLine
Public queries rescan by default; watcher optional, not correctness authority
202-file generated fixture is not 10k/50k performance evidence; T26 remains pending
Full baseline is not G4 or production qualification; G4-G6 NOT_RUN, NOT_QUALIFIED
